description:
Implement the Topology lens showing Captures, BacklogItems, Initiatives, and Scenarios with depends_on, member_of, classified_as, and targets edges.

This work should:
- initiative-based clustering: items with an initiative grouped into collapsed clusters showing rollup counts (total/completed/in_progress/failed/pending), expand on click; items without initiative in 'Unassigned' group
- default filter: hide completed/archived items
- node cap: if unclustered visible nodes exceed ~50, auto-collapse lowest-priority items into a 'More items' pseudo-node with count
- scenario impact: resolve acceptance_allow globs to show which items target which scenarios via targets edges
- edge complexity: above 300 visible edges switch to lightweight straight edges; above 500 suggest user narrow filters
- MiniMap: show when node count > 20, hide when > 120
- inspector actions per node type (Topology context):
  - Capture: classify, create item from suggestion, delete
  - BacklogItem: edit, queue, workshop, add dependency, assign initiative, view files
  - Initiative: edit, add/remove items, archive
  - Scenario: view files, edit metadata
name: swarm-manager-topology-impact-views
title: Build Topology and Scenario Impact Views in the Graph Workspace
